ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the ventral field, bounded by low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing and leading edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black borders on the trailing edges and distal tips; a central black vertical band at the notch area. Four primary amorphous yellowish-tan zones are mapped in the lower-inner and upper-outer quadrants of both lobes. Sparse black focal spots and streaks are distributed throughout the white central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a sharply defined apex and symmetrical divergence of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire visible trailing edge; pixel-level amplitude shows irregular peaks and valleys, with more pronounced jaggedness on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep from the medial notch to the distal tips, indicating a raised fluke posture.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A distinct circular high-contrast ring (possible parasite or attachment scar) located in the mid-medial region of the right lobe; small white circular clusters are visible near the peduncle insertion.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe, including a long, dark, curved stroke on the outer mid-section and several smaller vertical rake marks on the lower interior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable circular scar on the right lobe and multiple linear rake-mark abrasions on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan biological film (diatom accumulation) localized primarily in the lower-central regions of both fluke lobes.
